messages:
Sam V.P. Product: Heads-up — HelixCorp renewal next week. They're pressing for a 99.9% tail latency SLA <250ms on embeddings endpoints. Sales says deal-breaker.
Maria (Sales): Confirmed. Legal will push for credits if we can't commit. Helix is top ARR this quarter. :worried:
Tom (CS): Observed periodic long tails on large-batch reranks hitting cold KV caches on Dedicated.
Jess (Eng): We can probably reach 250ms@99.9% with prefix caching + KV warmers + smaller batch windows. Not trivial. Rough estimate: 2 engs x 2 weeks to deliver a safe canary and test harness.
Nina (Eng Manager): That's about 160 eng-hours plus infra testing. Pulling those people out affects the autoscaler sprint. If we delay autoscaler, unit costs might rise for other customers.
Maria (Sales): Could we offer a staged SLA? 2-week pilot, then formal SLA if canary meets targets. Helix might accept capped credits and staged rollout.
Sam V.P. Product: Let's run a quick RICE in chat. Reach = single large renewal, Impact = high (churn risk), Confidence = moderate, Effort = medium. I'm leaning to prioritize a minimal canary and keep the autoscaler MVP.
Jess (Eng): Quick calc:
```
Reach: 1
Impact: 9
Confidence: 6
Effort: 4
Score ≈ (1*9*6)/4 = 13.5
```
Supports carving out canary work.
Tom (CS): Non-monetary upside: warmers reduce cold tails for other Dedicated customers too.
Nina (Eng Manager): Ops note: warmers will slightly increase steady-state infra cost. Need approval for the monthly delta.
Sam V.P. Product: Proposal: carve out a 2-week SLA canary (1 infra + 1 application eng) to implement prefix caching, KV warmers, and canary load tests. Defer one low-priority refactor from infra sprint to free capacity. Sales gets staged SLA language.
Maria (Sales): Helix wants canary metrics within 10 business days and weekly checkpoints. I'll commit to that cadence.
Jess (Eng): I'll post a task list + e2e runbook by EOD. If we get approvals, I can deploy a staging canary in ~9 working days.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled: canary/warmers -> staging at 1715101200 by Jess (Eng)
Sam V.P. Product: Action items: Jess -> detailed tasks today; Nina -> resource/cost approval; Maria -> staged SLA draft to legal. Reconvene 24h. :white_check_mark:
